fresh_initialization: Original Qwen3.8-27B + fresh identical-seed LoRA for each candidate and formal training; no old adapters
lr_selection: Full4727 validation vLLM greedy Macro-F1; smallest LR on exact ties; test excluded
checkpoint_selection: Full validation vLLM Macro-F1 across3 epochs; earliest epoch on exact ties; test excluded
scheduler: 10% linear warmup +90% cosine decay to zero, independently for each pilot and full formal run
batch_rule: Largest stable native1280x1152 single-GPU microbatch with2GiB reserved headroom; accumulation1
precision: BF16 original base and forward; FP32 LoRA and AdamW
image_method: Existing sixplot, all200points/all6channels; fixed training-derived axis limits; no IMU2IMG converter
loss: Answer JSON+EOS token CE; input/image/padding masked; no augmentation, resampling, loss weighting or dropped windows
sampling: Single-rank seeded sampler; repeat reshuffled training set if a100-update pilot exhausts the data; candidates get identical order

tracking.logs: Every optimizer update loss/LR/gradnorm; per-epoch validation NLL; generated validation F1 stored separately

test_note: Fixed dog-disjoint test set was viewed historically; no new test feedback used to select LR/epoch. Extra LR-search training compute is recorded.
